entry_state: Plan reserve capacity, earned awards, delivered common shares and expense are distinct. The performance schedule derives units from an evidenced percentile and absolute-return cap, then applies employment and dividend-equivalent terms. Missing rank conventions and individual inputs stay unresolved. Later agreement versions are now introduced to narrow which termination and delivery rights apply.
exit_state: Versioned award terms distinguish surviving rights from delivery. The financing methods distinguish contractual cash, carrying value, classification and legal discharge. Early repurchase allocates debt and equity consideration; induced conversion measures added rights at amendment. The separate-date example releases debt on binding acceptance on 5 January and delivers shares on 20 January; its explanation continues next.
findings: General and CEO award forms produce different surviving units under matched hypothetical conditions, without moving payment to severance or identifying an actual grant.
The compound-bond PV and accretion preserve exact fractions before rounding. Alternative classification and changed terms are explicitly outside that example.
The ten-percent debt test is inclusive and limited to the stated issuer analysis; qualitative conditions and legal release remain necessary.
Early repurchase and inducement use different valuation questions. The separate-date case identifies announcement, binding amendment, discharge and delivery. No new confirmed local defect.
